biggest_catch: Account must be opened in person at a Patelco branch using promo code R7BWNBFB with a $100 minimum deposit — online account opening does not qualify, and the second $50 requires opening a Money Market account too.
catches: The checking account must be opened at a Patelco branch (California Bay Area footprint) — opening online does not qualify for this offer.
Promo code R7BWNBFB must be used at account opening; a $100 minimum deposit is required.
Student Checking is for ages 13-17; students 18 and older get the same offer on Free Checking instead.
The extra $50 is only earned by also opening a Money Market Select or Money Market Plus account after meeting the checking reward requirement.
The $50 checking reward is credited to the savings account within 5 business days of the qualifying new account being opened — not instantly at the branch.
Offer is advertised as 'for a limited time' with no stated end date on the official page — it can be withdrawn without notice.
If you receive $600 or more in Patelco prizes/bonuses in a year, Patelco sends an IRS Form 1099 (bonus is taxable income).
A parent/guardian can be a joint owner; the teen needs a valid unexpired US passport, state ID/driver's license, or school ID with photo.

steps: Visit a Patelco branch with the teen's valid unexpired US passport, state ID/driver's license, or school ID with photo (a parent can join as joint owner).

Open a new Student Checking account (ages 13-17; ages 18+ open Free Checking for the same offer) as a new Patelco member, using promo code R7BWNBFB and making the $100 minimum deposit. Online opening does not qualify.
The $50 checking reward is credited to the savings account within 5 business days of the qualifying account being opened.
Optional: open a Money Market Select or Money Market Plus account to earn the additional $50, credited to the money market account.
